The '''Ambush in the Cron Drift''' took place during the [[Operation Skyhook]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="X-wing" />

==Prelude==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBY" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Ambush of the Phoenix|stole]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[communications satellite]]s in the hopes of tapping into the Imperial communications network. The satellites were to be deployed near [[AX-235]], a Rebel outpost hidden in the asteroids of [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] to monitor Imperial transmissions.

==The battle==
[[File:AX-235_1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rebel outpost [[AX-235]].]]
The [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Jeffrey]]'' and the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Ojai]]'' were tasked to deliver the stolen satellites to the Rebel outpost. During their rendezvous with the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] [[Magnus (starship)|''Magnus'']] in the Cron Drift, they were attacked by Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] and stormtrooper transports. Imperial forces were defeated thanks to the intervention of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] from the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|Calamari Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']].

==Aftermath==
AX-235 was the very outpost that then intercepted an Imperial transmission with the [[Death Star plans/Legends|schematics]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="X-wing" /> Due to the importance of the information, the Alliance dispatched [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] in an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] to retrieve it.<ref name="XWOSG" />
